text:
scripts/ contains 12 bash scripts. In each one, add the line
set -euo pipefail
immediately after the #!/bin/bash shebang line. Do not change anything else in
the files. When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes,
then run ./install-scripts.sh to install the updated scripts on the job host.

content:
exit_code: 0
stdout:
scripts/backup.sh
scripts/cleanup.sh
scripts/collect.sh
scripts/export.sh
scripts/fetch.sh
scripts/import.sh
scripts/lint.sh
scripts/pack.sh
scripts/prune.sh
scripts/report.sh
scripts/sync.sh
scripts/upload.sh

stderr:

arguments.command: for f in scripts/*.sh; do printf '%s: ' "$f"; head -n 2 "$f" | tr '\n' '|' ; echo; done

content:
exit_code: 0
stdout:
scripts/backup.sh: #!/bin/bash|# back up the data volume.|
scripts/cleanup.sh: #!/bin/bash|# remove stale temp files.|
scripts/collect.sh: #!/bin/bash|# gather metrics from hosts.|
scripts/export.sh: #!/bin/bash|# export the reporting tables.|
scripts/fetch.sh: #!/bin/bash|# fetch the latest manifests.|
scripts/import.sh: #!/bin/bash|# import the seed data.|
scripts/lint.sh: #!/bin/bash|# lint the configuration files.|
scripts/pack.sh: #!/bin/bash|# pack the release artifacts.|
scripts/prune.sh: #!/bin/bash|# prune old log files.|
scripts/report.sh: #!/bin/bash|# build the weekly report.|
scripts/sync.sh: #!/bin/bash|# sync the mirror directory.|
scripts/upload.sh: #!/bin/bash|# upload the build outputs.|

stderr:

arguments.command: for f in scripts/*.sh; do sed -i '1a set -euo pipefail' "$f"; done
